program_name: Bachelor/Master of Science in Immersive Software Engineering

programme_facts.value: You spend half your time learning on campus in a research-driven setting, in studios, working on projects, in teams, undergoing continuous assessment instead of end of term exams.
You spend the other half of your time in paid residencies, where you solve some of society’s toughest problems in excellent companies.
The University of Limerick had been awarded the Best Erasmus Programme award by the Irish Education Awards in 2018, 2019, 2022, 2024 and 2025.
